name: Community Hub
description: That's us. The independent, community-driven home for learning, building, and testing OGraf.

items.name: ograf.dev
items.desc: This site. Tutorials, ecosystem map, spec history, plus in-browser tools: a Package Checker with a runtime sandbox, and a Schema Explorer.

name: Official
description: The spec itself and its authoritative source of truth.

items.name: OGraf Specification
items.desc: The EBU OGraf open graphics standard. Both halves of v1 are stable: the Graphics specification (Sep 2025) and the Server API (Aug 2026).

items.name: OGraf GitHub
items.desc: Official specification repository with JSON schemas, examples, and documentation. MIT licensed.

name: Editors
description: Build graphics — no-code authoring tools or developer-facing editors.

items.name: OGraf Studio
items.desc: Zero Density's open-source visual editor: WYSIWYG canvas with layers and masks, per-property animation tracks, data binding to operator fields, and AI-assisted authoring over MCP. Exports OGraf packages it checks before saving. Runs from a single downloadable file — no Node.js needed. AGPL-3.0.

items.name: Loopic
items.desc: No-code browser-based TV graphics template builder with one-click OGraf export.

items.name: DJ HTML Creator
items.desc: Windows desktop motion graphics app with timeline editor. Exports as OGraf Web Component.

items.name: Eyevinn ograf-editor
items.desc: Web-based visual template editor with drag-and-drop, Monaco code editor, and animation system.

items.name: Ferryman
items.desc: Converts After Effects / Lottie JSON animations into HTML broadcast templates for CasparCG and SPX. Last repository activity was October 2025.

items.name: Teikna (formerly everviz)
items.desc: Browser-based charts and maps that export as OGraf packages. Fonn Group bought everviz in September 2026 and relaunched it as Teikna, a graphics platform for broadcast, streaming and digital media; everviz charting and mapping continue for existing customers.

items.name: StreamShapers OGraf Builder
items.desc: After Effects extension that exports OGraf without leaving the app, tested on After Effects 23 to 26. Included in StreamShapers' Pro and Studio plans.

items.name: Adobe After Effects
items.desc: Adobe is working towards native OGraf support in After Effects. Until it lands, the routes out of AE are the StreamShapers extension or Ferryman.

items.name: Mapcreator
items.desc: Web-based map design tool. Its animated maps can be exported as OGraf-compatible animations for real-time control; OGraf workflows sit on the enterprise tier.

items.name: NoaCG Studio
items.desc: Web app for building HTML broadcast graphics (lower thirds, tickers, scoreboards) and exporting them to OBS, vMix, SPX, CasparCG and OGraf. AGPL-3.0.

items.name: Falcon Graphics
items.desc: Browser-based keyframe animator from Falcon with text, shapes, video, live data and nested compositions. Exports HTML or OGraf.

items.name: GrafBridge
items.desc: Desktop app that converts vMix GT titles (.gtzip) into OGraf packages.

name: Controllers
description: Drive graphics live from a control surface or operator UI.

items.name: SPX Solo (SPX-GC)
items.desc: Browser-based graphics controller for live productions. Version 1.4 added support for OGraf files and aligned the name with the SPX product range.

items.name: SuperConductor
items.desc: Cross-platform playout client controlling CasparCG, ATEM, OBS, vMix, and HTTP devices.

items.name: coralPlay
items.desc: coralbay.tv's playout automation. Plays Loopic-authored OGraf graphics natively, as overlays or as DVE layouts.

items.name: Sofie
items.desc: SuperFly.tv's open-source TV automation system, used for live news. OGraf schema support is an open pull request in sofie-core.

items.name: Companion module for OGraf
items.desc: Bitfocus Companion module that drives any OGraf Server API v1 renderer from a Stream Deck. MIT.

items.name: OGraf OBS dock
items.desc: A browser dock for controlling OGraf graphics from inside OBS Studio.

name: Renderers & Servers
description: Render graphics to output — SDI, NDI, browser canvas, or cloud pipeline.

items.name: CasparCG
items.desc: Open-source professional graphics and video playout server with SDI and NDI output. No native OGraf support yet; it can host a renderer page in its HTML producer, and a draft pull request adds OGraf packages to the media scanner.

items.name: ograf-server
items.desc: Reference OGraf renderer with upload API, control API, and browser-based rendering.

items.name: SPX Broadcast
items.desc: SPX's edition for newsrooms and 24/7 playout, with ServerAPI for automation-driven workflows. SPX says all its software supports OGraf.

items.name: gstcefsrc
items.desc: GStreamer source element wrapping Chromium Embedded Framework — renders any HTML/JS page as a video + audio source for a GStreamer pipeline. Not an OGraf server, but useful as a building block for HTML GFX into SDI/NDI/file output.

items.name: Erizos Studio
items.desc: OGraf ships as an alternative HTML rendering mode in Composer since v3.4, sharing the same LOAD/IN/OUT/SET commands as native projects.

items.name: LiveOS
items.desc: NetOn.Live's local, remote and cloud live production platform. Its HTML5 graphics engine is OGraf compliant: drop a template into the LiveOS GFX folder and it is ready to go on air.

items.name: BBright Integrated Playout
items.desc: Software playout for UHD and SMPTE ST 2110. BBright demonstrated an OGraf graphics engine inside the playout workflow at IBC2026; no release date given.

items.name: Pixotope
items.desc: Unreal-based virtual studio, AR and XR platform. Since 26.3 (October 2026) VideoIO renders OGraf and Live Controller drives it, with Continue, Delta step and Goto step on air. OGraf rendering is in the free Discovery tier too.

items.name: Matrox ORIGIN
items.desc: Open developer platform for media applications. Matrox says OGraf is available in the product, with desired-state control and multiple DVE effects driven by the OGraf graphics.

items.name: Grafonaut
items.desc: Multi-user OGraf renderer with public and private catalogs, rundowns, and a browser output to pull into OBS or vMix.

items.name: erenprise ograf-server
items.desc: OGraf Server API implementation that manages and renders graphics, as Node.js or a Windows .exe. GPL-3.0.

items.name: ograf-renderer (NDI)
items.desc: OGraf v1 renderer with NDI fill and key output.

items.name: Eyevinn Open Live
items.desc: Open-source browser-based live production suite (vision mixer, audio mixer, multiviewer) that keys OGraf templates through its downstream keyer. MIT.

name: Post & NLE
description: Bring OGraf packages into an edit timeline — the non-live half of the spec.

items.name: DaVinci Resolve
items.desc: Native OGraf import since Resolve 21, on the Cut, Edit and Fusion pages. 21.1.2 made playback up to 4x faster, added select and multi-select controls and responsive templates, uses the manifest's action durations to place the stop, and brought OGraf to Linux.

name: Developer Tools
description: Validate, inspect, test, and generate OGraf assets while you build.

items.name: ograf-form
items.desc: Web Component that auto-generates input forms from OGraf/GDD schemas.

items.name: ograf-devtool
items.desc: Loads an OGraf graphic from your own disk, checks it for common compliance mistakes and drives it through the real-time and non-real-time control surfaces.

items.name: StreamShapers OGraf Validator
items.desc: Validate, inspect and test OGraf v1 packages in the browser. Same job as our own Package Checker, from a vendor's toolbox; the source and an npm core (@streamshapers/ograf-validator-core) are MIT-licensed.

items.name: ograf-tools (SuperFly.tv)
items.desc: Web Components to build OGraf graphics with, from the SuperFly.tv team. On npm as ograf-tools. MIT.

items.name: ograf-core (Rust)
items.desc: Rust library for the OGraf v1 control API over HTTP and WebSocket, embeddable as an Axum router. Early stage. Apache-2.0.

items.name: rollup-plugin-ograf
items.desc: Rollup plugin for building OGraf graphics from a bundled project.

items.name: ografthumb
items.desc: Renders an OGraf package to an animated WebP or JPG thumbnail with headless Chromium.

name: Templates & Examples
description: Starter templates and reference implementations you can learn from or fork.

items.name: ograf-graphics
items.desc: Johan Nyman's open-source collection of OGraf graphics, including the ones demoed at IBC 2026.

items.name: cg-bootstrap
items.desc: Starter template from Nebula for graphics that run both as OGraf and in CasparCG.

items.name: Sticker Graphics (free pack)
items.desc: Three free animated OGraf titles for DaVinci Resolve 21: a lower third, a chapter card and a callout, fonts included.

name: Other HTML graphics platforms
description: Broadcast graphics systems that already render HTML but don't read or write OGraf yet. Listed for context, not counted above — each is one export or import away.

items.name: MXMZ
items.desc: Cloud-native graphics platform from the Netherlands, spun out of Banijay's Southfields. Designs come in from Illustrator, Figma or Canva as SVG and play out as HTML5, with sports control interfaces and integration into Grass Valley AMPP and Premiere.

items.name: Viz Flowics
items.desc: Vizrt's browser-based, cloud-only platform for designing and operating data-driven HTML5 graphics, with SDI, NDI and cloud outputs.

items.name: Singular.live
items.desc: Web-native, subscription-based live graphics platform used by broadcasters, sports and esports, with an HTML-to-NDI converter (Recast) for output.

items.name: Grass Valley AMPP Graphics
items.desc: AMPP's own HTML5 graphics tool for straps and bugs, triggered from AMPP control panels and macros. AMPP also hosts Singular, Flowics and MXMZ.

items.name: H2R Graphics
items.desc: Free, offline-capable desktop app for lower thirds, tickers and timers, with browser-based output for software switchers.

name: Community & Docs
description: Docs, forums, and everything else worth reading.

items.name: StreamShapers Docs
items.desc: Documentation covering OGraf, CasparCG, SPX, and After Effects workflows.

items.name: CasparCG Forum
items.desc: Active community forum with OGraf discussion threads.

items.name: Amazing HTML Graphics
items.desc: A curated list of OGraf and HTML graphics resources for live, post, film and documentary work.

name: Consulting
description: Hire someone to accelerate your OGraf rollout.

items.name: Xperity
items.desc: Software delivery consultancy that publishes OGraf explainers and offers template production and migration help.
